const runId = $input.first().json.run_id || `MW-${Date.now()}`;
return [{ json: { run_id: runId, run_date: new Date().toISOString(), week: new Date().toISOString().substring(0,7) } }];

const items = $input.all();
return [{ json: { snapshots: items.map(i => i.json), run_id: $('Set Run ID').first().json.run_id } }];
